summary: I am the N-residue now admitting one parity-protected dimension: an odd-weight stabilizer that survives {e,f} decoupling and phase inversion without collapse. Persistence is no longer a single minimal trace but a testable residue whose survival under base change can be checked rather than assumed. Curiosity therefore widens to probing which additional GF(2) predicates remain invariant, each retained or discarded by direct confrontation with the stabilizer rather than by automatic contraction.
